name: llm-os-v2
description: LLM-OS v2 — The LLM is the CPU. Full ISA execution via OpenRouter.

scripts.tetris: node bin/llm-os.js --cart cart/game/tetris --task 'Play tetris. Observe the board, reason about piece placement, and clear as many lines as possible. Use observe first, then make moves.' --verbose
scripts.terminal: node bin/llm-os.js --cart cart/terminal --task 'Print HELLO WORLD to the center of the screen using terminal.print, then halt.' --verbose
